content: The Events Calendar free (wordpress.org, v6.18.2 2026-10-15): month/list/day views, event search, venues & organisers, categories & tags, Google Calendar and iCal exporting, REST API, JSON-LD structured data, responsive. Pro/Filter Bar: filter by category, tag, venue, price, city; recurring events; week/photo/map views; Community add-on = user submissions; Event Aggregator imports ICS/Google/Meetup/Eventbrite/CSV. A 2026 user review complains calendar views/exports generate huge numbers of crawlable URLs and server load from bots.
